tools.description: Calculates Cyprus income tax, employee/self-employed SI, GESY and take-home pay. Employee SI and first-employment relief use qualifying employment remuneration only; rent does not increase employee SI. GESY uses the shared €180,000 personal ceiling. Use for a Cyprus resident or non-resident employee

tools.name: list_saved_calculations
tools.description: Lists metadata of an authenticated user's saved calculations by calculator type. Use so an agent can help a user find a previously saved scenario before loading it. Never returns encrypted contents.

tools.name: load_saved_calculation
tools.description: Loads one saved calculation belonging to the authenticated API key's user. Use after list_saved_calculations to retrieve full details of a specific saved scenario. Locked saves return locked: true and no contents.

tools.name: save_calculation
tools.description: Saves a calculator scenario to the authenticated user's stored history. Use when the user asks to save, keep or remember a scenario. Stores the inputs unencrypted (with server-computed results) so list/load can return them later.

tools.name: update_calculation
tools.description: Renames a saved calculation and/or replaces its inputs (recomputing results). Use when the user asks to rename a save or re-run it with different inputs. Encrypted saves stay locked.

tools.name: delete_saved_calculation
tools.description: Deletes one saved calculation belonging to the authenticated API key's user. Use when the user asks to delete or forget a saved scenario. Works on encrypted saves too.

tools.name: compare_saved_calculations
tools.description: Diffs two saved calculations (inputs and results) field by field. Use for 'compare my mortgage before/after' style questions instead of reconstructing the diff from two loads. Encrypted sides report locked instead of contents.

tools.name: parse_portfolio_csv

tools.name: parse_mortgage_statement_text

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "calculate_cyprus_income_tax" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
